verdict.rationale: Stagehand is agent-facing browser automation tooling with a server-side component, so scoped agent credentials are a fair question to ask. The evidence pack never documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens for an agent. The only security mention is a generic 'network-level security' tagline, which is a different feature, and MCP and Browserbase session features are unrelated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
